testcase.name: legacy custom JSON keeps the original per serving meaning
branded global exact match survives local family retrieval
family is not identity and explicit constraints cannot be dropped
nutrient denominator is independent of household portion
weak candidate never becomes AUTO just because macros look plausible
resolved utensils stay locked instead of becoming whole foods
volume nutrients and mass nutrients retain their declared denominator
global portions normalize before comparing nutrient differences
manual corrections preserve distinct cooking mentions without reviving removed foods
curated origin stays eligible when nutrient provenance becomes explicit
confirmed USDA mass profiles do not inherit a visual ml denominator
neighboring bread names and mixed dishes cannot replace a declared ingredient
unavailable cooked variant cannot claim that the raw profile is cooked
